hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
hypotheses.fit_reason: Stage-2 evidence shows pointer arithmetic (ptr + 6) without bounds checking, leading to potential memory access outside intended buffer boundary
The ptr + 6 operation directly leads to a read that may access memory before or beyond the valid buffer range, as evidenced by the missing bounds validation
The pointer arithmetic operation suggests potential off-by-one issues in buffer boundary calculations, where the offset calculation may exceed valid buffer limits
